title: sdks-unify-auth-retries-streaming-parity-v1.58.0
author: Asha Mehta
release_notes: SDKs: unify auth/retries and streaming ergonomics; patch parity fixes for Python/TS/Go; bump SDK versions to v1.58.0. No breaking API changes for users.
description:
Motivation: Teams reported subtle differences between the Python, TypeScript and Go SDKs around auth retry behavior and streaming ergonomics. This causes intermittent 401/429 handling differences and makes cross-language examples brittle. This PR unifies the auth+retry middleware, improves streaming ergonomics (async iterator + abort/signal parity), and applies parity fixes across SDKs.

What this changes (high-level):
- Unify auth retry logic across Python/TS/Go: central backoff strategy, refresh-on-401 hook, consistent header/metadata propagation.
- Streaming ergonomics: make streaming interfaces consistent (Python: async iterator; TS: AsyncIterable + AbortSignal; Go: context-aware streamer). Add reconnect/backpressure handling in client-side helpers.
- Parity fixes: small bug fixes surfaced in cross-language tests (multipart boundary handling in Go, chunk framing in TS, keep-alive in Python).
- Version bumps: all SDKs bumped to v1.58.0 with changelogs updated.
- Tests: added e2e tests for streaming reconnect, added unit tests for retry/backoff policy and auth refresh.

Checklist:
- [x] Implement unified retry middleware in each SDK
- [x] Update streaming client ergonomics and docs samples
- [x] Add unit + e2e tests
- [x] Update changelogs and package versions to v1.58.0
- [x] Run CI and fix lint/test regressions

Notes on compatibility: The changes are designed to be non-breaking. We preserved existing public method names and added backward-compatible overloads where ergonomic improvements required new parameters (e.g. optional AbortSignal). Consumers upgrading should read the changelog for minor semantics around retry timings (defaults are preserved).

Related linear tickets: ENG-4821 (SDK parity), ENG-4890 (streaming ergonomics). Support ticket SUP-3302 reported the original 401 + retry loop issue that motivated the refresh behavior fix.
